meta.title: Phantoms In The Dark
meta.description: The fallen star follows the undertow ever deeper.

units.rawText: Below the towering purple walls, two points of white light nimbly weave through packs of wandering Entropics, headed for a set of safe coordinates acquired from past memories.
units.displayText: Below the towering purple walls, two points of white light nimbly weave through packs of wandering Entropics, headed for a set of safe coordinates acquired from past memories.

spans.text: Below the towering purple walls, two points of white light nimbly weave through packs of wandering Entropics, headed for a set of safe coordinates acquired from past memories.

units.rawText: Several Entropics are present amidst the destination coordinates. One of the Sanctifiers draws the blade at her waist and nods to her companion.
units.displayText: Several Entropics are present amidst the destination coordinates. One of the Sanctifiers draws the blade at her waist and nods to her companion.

spans.text: Several Entropics are present amidst the destination coordinates. One of the Sanctifiers draws the blade at her waist and nods to her companion.

units.rawText: After receiving a nod of assent, she quickly circles around behind the first one, and with a deft combination of nimble footwork and practiced bladework, she cleaves it in half, from head to foot.
units.displayText: After receiving a nod of assent, she quickly circles around behind the first one, and with a deft combination of nimble footwork and practiced bladework, she cleaves it in half, from head to foot.

spans.text: After receiving a nod of assent, she quickly circles around behind the first one, and with a deft combination of nimble footwork and practiced bladework, she cleaves it in half, from head to foot.

units.rawText: Hss—
units.displayText: Hss—

spans.text: Hss—

units.rawText: The disturbance draws the attention of the other Entropic. It descends from above and thrusts its tentacles at the Sanctifier's chest. The Sanctifier backsteps like a fading dream, but the pendant bottle dangling from her necklace spills forth from her vestments, briefly held back by its inertia.
units.displayText: The disturbance draws the attention of the other Entropic. It descends from above and thrusts its tentacles at the Sanctifier's chest. The Sanctifier backsteps like a fading dream, but the pendant bottle dangling from her necklace spills forth from her vestments, briefly held back by its inertia.

spans.text: The disturbance draws the attention of the other Entropic. It descends from above and thrusts its tentacles at the Sanctifier's chest. The Sanctifier backsteps like a fading dream, but the pendant bottle dangling from her necklace spills forth from her vestments, briefly held back by its inertia.

units.rawText: The Sanctifier reflexively leans backward and the tentacles just barely graze the bottle. She grits her teeth and severs the tentacles apart, causing her opponent to recoil in pain. The Sanctifier exploits this opening and reverses her grip to finish off the purple monstrosity in a single blow.
units.displayText: The Sanctifier reflexively leans backward and the tentacles just barely graze the bottle. She grits her teeth and severs the tentacles apart, causing her opponent to recoil in pain. The Sanctifier exploits this opening and reverses her grip to finish off the purple monstrosity in a single blow.

The Sanctifier exploits this opening and reverses her grip to finish off the purple monstrosity in a single blow.

units.rawText: Whew... Good thing it's not broken.
units.displayText: Whew... Good thing it's not broken.

spans.text: Whew... Good thing it's not broken.

units.rawText: She carefully examines the bottle and only puts it away after seeing that the little green leaf inside is intact.
units.displayText: She carefully examines the bottle and only puts it away after seeing that the little green leaf inside is intact.

spans.text: She carefully examines the bottle and only puts it away after seeing that the little green leaf inside is intact.

units.rawText: Her decisive ambush has cleared all the remaining enemies out from around the safehouse, and the two Sanctifiers are afforded a brief respite.
units.displayText: Her decisive ambush has cleared all the remaining enemies out from around the safehouse, and the two Sanctifiers are afforded a brief respite.

spans.text: Her decisive ambush has cleared all the remaining enemies out from around the safehouse, and the two Sanctifiers are afforded a brief respite.

units.rawText: The Sanctifier carrying a longsword pulls her hood down and her flattened cat ears spring upright again, twitching excitedly as they return to normal.
units.displayText: The Sanctifier carrying a longsword pulls her hood down and her flattened cat ears spring upright again, twitching excitedly as they return to normal.

spans.text: The Sanctifier carrying a longsword pulls her hood down and her flattened cat ears spring upright again, twitching excitedly as they return to normal.

units.rawText: All threats eliminated. No irregularities detected.
units.displayText: All threats eliminated. No irregularities detected.

spans.text: All threats eliminated. No irregularities detected.

units.rawText: Now deactivating Spoof Code. Professor, we're safe for now.
units.displayText: Now deactivating Spoof Code. Professor, we're safe for now.

spans.text: Now deactivating Spoof Code. Professor, we're safe for now.

units.rawText: I check our surroundings again, and after ensuring everything is fine, I lower my hood like she did.
units.displayText: I check our surroundings again, and after ensuring everything is fine, I lower my hood like she did.

spans.text: I check our surroundings again, and after ensuring everything is fine, I lower my hood like she did.

units.rawText: I saw that Entropic ambush you from above just now. Are you alright?
units.displayText: I saw that Entropic ambush you from above just now. Are you alright?

spans.text: I saw that Entropic ambush you from above just now. Are you alright?

units.rawText: It was just a couple of Low Order Entropics. While there was a little surprise during the process of eliminating them, it's nothing to worry about.
units.displayText: It was just a couple of Low Order Entropics. While there was a little surprise during the process of eliminating them, it's nothing to worry about.

spans.text: It was just a couple of Low Order Entropics. While there was a little surprise during the process of eliminating them, it's nothing to worry about.

units.rawText: How did you know there was a safehouse here, Professor?
units.displayText: How did you know there was a safehouse here, Professor?

spans.text: How did you know there was a safehouse here, Professor?

units.rawText: Do you remember that neural fragment from Eosphorus? When he and his previous party of Sanctifiers launched their raid on Tartarus, they rested here too.
units.displayText: Do you remember that neural fragment from Eosphorus? When he and his previous party of Sanctifiers launched their raid on Tartarus, they rested here too.

spans.text: Do you remember that neural fragment from Eosphorus? When he and his previous party of Sanctifiers launched their raid on Tartarus, they rested here too.

units.rawText: This place...
units.displayText: This place...

spans.text: This place...

units.rawText: As everything began here, so too shall it end here.
units.displayText: As everything began here, so too shall it end here.

spans.text: As everything began here, so too shall it end here.

units.rawText: Malkira and Eosphorus are the two greatest leaders on the Cloud, immortal and eternal. Now that they are working together, we are not strong enough to fight them.
units.displayText: Malkira and Eosphorus are the two greatest leaders on the Cloud, immortal and eternal. Now that they are working together, we are not strong enough to fight them.

spans.text: Malkira and Eosphorus are the two greatest leaders on the Cloud, immortal and eternal. Now that they are working together, we are not strong enough to fight them.

units.rawText: Fortunately, Malkira offered us an olive branch of her own accord. If we can convince her to stop supporting Eosphorus and to tear off that fallen angel's wings, we just might have a shot at turning the tables.
units.displayText: Fortunately, Malkira offered us an olive branch of her own accord. If we can convince her to stop supporting Eosphorus and to tear off that fallen angel's wings, we just might have a shot at turning the tables.

spans.text: Fortunately, Malkira offered us an olive branch of her own accord. If we can convince her to stop supporting Eosphorus and to tear off that fallen angel's wings, we just might have a shot at turning the tables.

units.rawText: Essentially, this is our only choice. However, if we can't persuade her...
units.displayText: Essentially, this is our only choice. However, if we can't persuade her...

spans.text: Essentially, this is our only choice. However, if we can't persuade her...

units.rawText: I'm also prepared to face Malkira in battle.
units.displayText: I'm also prepared to face Malkira in battle.

spans.text: I'm also prepared to face Malkira in battle.

units.rawText: I've considered the worst that could happen. No matter what comes to pass, I will ensure that you, at least, can withdraw safely.
units.displayText: I've considered the worst that could happen. No matter what comes to pass, I will ensure that you, at least, can withdraw safely.

spans.text: I've considered the worst that could happen. No matter what comes to pass, I will ensure that you, at least, can withdraw safely.

units.rawText: As long as you're safe, then there is still hope. I'm sure you can lead the Exiles in turning any situation around, no matter what kind of difficulty we face...
units.displayText: As long as you're safe, then there is still hope. I'm sure you can lead the Exiles in turning any situation around, no matter what kind of difficulty we face...

spans.text: As long as you're safe, then there is still hope. I'm sure you can lead the Exiles in turning any situation around, no matter what kind of difficulty we face...

units.rawText: Persicaria's voice is quiet, laced with a determination that cannot be denied. I place my hand over hers; it is ice-cold.
units.displayText: Persicaria's voice is quiet, laced with a determination that cannot be denied. I place my hand over hers; it is ice-cold.

spans.text: Persicaria's voice is quiet, laced with a determination that cannot be denied. I place my hand over hers; it is ice-cold.

units.rawText: You don't need to keep thinking about the worst-case scenario. We're facing the Entropic mastermind, so I know our chances are slim. But with proper preparations, "slim" doesn't have to mean "nonexistent".
units.displayText: You don't need to keep thinking about the worst-case scenario. We're facing the Entropic mastermind, so I know our chances are slim. But with proper preparations, "slim" doesn't have to mean "nonexistent".

spans.text: You don't need to keep thinking about the worst-case scenario. We're facing the Entropic mastermind, so I know our chances are slim. But with proper preparations, "slim" doesn't have to mean "nonexistent".

units.rawText: Believe in me. At the very least, we'll be facing her together this time.
units.displayText: Believe in me. At the very least, we'll be facing her together this time.

spans.text: Believe in me. At the very least, we'll be facing her together this time.

units.rawText: Persicaria's stern expression slowly softens, and she giggles.
units.displayText: Persicaria's stern expression slowly softens, and she giggles.

spans.text: Persicaria's stern expression slowly softens, and she giggles.

units.rawText: Pffft...
units.displayText: Pffft...

spans.text: Pffft...

units.rawText: Now where have I seen this before...
units.displayText: Now where have I seen this before...

spans.text: Now where have I seen this before...

units.rawText: It was in the Enigma Sector, when ENIAC was devouring operands from all around. You were planning to enter the operand black hole in person...
units.displayText: It was in the Enigma Sector, when ENIAC was devouring operands from all around. You were planning to enter the operand black hole in person...

spans.text: It was in the Enigma Sector, when ENIAC was devouring operands from all around. You were planning to enter the operand black hole in person...

units.rawText: Ah yes, you said the same thing back then, Persicaria.
units.displayText: Ah yes, you said the same thing back then, Persicaria.

spans.text: Ah yes, you said the same thing back then, Persicaria.

units.rawText: Come to think of it, that was probably the first time I went on a mission to another sector with you, Professor.
units.displayText: Come to think of it, that was probably the first time I went on a mission to another sector with you, Professor.

spans.text: Come to think of it, that was probably the first time I went on a mission to another sector with you, Professor.

units.rawText: And now, it's just the two of us again...
units.displayText: And now, it's just the two of us again...

spans.text: And now, it's just the two of us again...

units.rawText: Plap!
units.displayText: Plap!

spans.text: Plap!

units.rawText: A sudden sound interrupts our conversation. A little purple blob spills out of my cloak and hits the ground. It wobbles from the impact and groans in discomfort before reaching out and grabbing my leg with tiny tentacles.
units.displayText: A sudden sound interrupts our conversation. A little purple blob spills out of my cloak and hits the ground. It wobbles from the impact and groans in discomfort before reaching out and grabbing my leg with tiny tentacles.

spans.text: A sudden sound interrupts our conversation. A little purple blob spills out of my cloak and hits the ground. It wobbles from the impact and groans in discomfort before reaching out and grabbing my leg with tiny tentacles.

units.rawText: Guh...
units.displayText: Guh...

spans.text: Guh...

units.rawText: Kiii... guhguh... huuu...
units.displayText: Kiii... guhguh... huuu...

spans.text: Kiii... guhguh... huuu...

units.rawText: ...Oh right, it's not just us. We've got this little guy too.
units.displayText: ...Oh right, it's not just us. We've got this little guy too.

spans.text: ...Oh right, it's not just us. We've got this little guy too.

units.rawText: Persicaria sighs, then bends down to check on the Diminutive Entropic before shaking her head in my direction.
units.displayText: Persicaria sighs, then bends down to check on the Diminutive Entropic before shaking her head in my direction.

spans.text: Persicaria sighs, then bends down to check on the Diminutive Entropic before shaking her head in my direction.

units.rawText: It doesn't seem hurt, but it doesn't show any signs of waking up either... It's been asleep ever since we entered Tartarus Sector, and its internal operand levels have been rising constantly.
units.displayText: It doesn't seem hurt, but it doesn't show any signs of waking up either... It's been asleep ever since we entered Tartarus Sector, and its internal operand levels have been rising constantly.

spans.text: It doesn't seem hurt, but it doesn't show any signs of waking up either... It's been asleep ever since we entered Tartarus Sector, and its internal operand levels have been rising constantly.

units.rawText: Malkira used it to speak with us previously and guided us here, but now it's not waking up...
units.displayText: Malkira used it to speak with us previously and guided us here, but now it's not waking up...

spans.text: Malkira used it to speak with us previously and guided us here, but now it's not waking up...

units.rawText: Perhaps this little guy's been influenced by the Tartarus Sector.
units.displayText: Perhaps this little guy's been influenced by the Tartarus Sector.

spans.text: Perhaps this little guy's been influenced by the Tartarus Sector.

units.rawText: Tartarus... It's a place bound by the rules made by man. According to Eosphorus' memories, Sanctifiers are weakened when they enter the Tartarus Sector.
units.displayText: Tartarus... It's a place bound by the rules made by man. According to Eosphorus' memories, Sanctifiers are weakened when they enter the Tartarus Sector.

spans.text: Tartarus... It's a place bound by the rules made by man. According to Eosphorus' memories, Sanctifiers are weakened when they enter the Tartarus Sector.

units.rawText: Then perhaps, Entropics become stronger after they enter Tartarus.
units.displayText: Then perhaps, Entropics become stronger after they enter Tartarus.

spans.text: Then perhaps, Entropics become stronger after they enter Tartarus.

units.rawText: This is just my hypothesis, but I think this tiny Entropic is sleeping because it's waiting to break out of its cocoon and evolve into a higher state of being.
units.displayText: This is just my hypothesis, but I think this tiny Entropic is sleeping because it's waiting to break out of its cocoon and evolve into a higher state of being.

spans.text: This is just my hypothesis, but I think this tiny Entropic is sleeping because it's waiting to break out of its cocoon and evolve into a higher state of being.

units.rawText: <color=red>That would indeed be correct.</color>
units.displayText: That would indeed be correct.

spans.text: That would indeed be correct.

units.rawText: The Diminutive Entropic has awakened from its slumber at some point and looks straight at me. Its round little body emits a mocking voice, a slithering invitation from the abyss.
units.displayText: The Diminutive Entropic has awakened from its slumber at some point and looks straight at me. Its round little body emits a mocking voice, a slithering invitation from the abyss.

spans.text: The Diminutive Entropic has awakened from its slumber at some point and looks straight at me. Its round little body emits a mocking voice, a slithering invitation from the abyss.

units.rawText: That familiar sense of foreboding makes me freeze in place, as if I've fallen into a hole in the ice. In my memories I see them again; that massive body, those writhing whip-like tentacles, that bewitching countenance, and they make me hesitate.
units.displayText: That familiar sense of foreboding makes me freeze in place, as if I've fallen into a hole in the ice. In my memories I see them again; that massive body, those writhing whip-like tentacles, that bewitching countenance, and they make me hesitate.

spans.text: That familiar sense of foreboding makes me freeze in place, as if I've fallen into a hole in the ice. In my memories I see them again; that massive body, those writhing whip-like tentacles, that bewitching countenance, and they make me hesitate.

units.rawText: Malkira.
units.displayText: Malkira.

spans.text: Malkira.

units.rawText: <color=red>Hoho...</color>
units.displayText: Hoho...

spans.text: Hoho...

units.rawText: <color=red>I'm glad you made the appointment, <cmdr>.</color>
units.displayText: I'm glad you made the appointment, {교수}.

spans.text: I'm glad you made the appointment,

units.rawText: Professor.
units.displayText: Professor.

spans.text: Professor.

units.rawText: Persicaria stands before me with her sword in hand, ready to attack the uninvited guest at any moment. I calm myself, then move up to stand beside Persicaria before returning Malkira's gaze.
units.displayText: Persicaria stands before me with her sword in hand, ready to attack the uninvited guest at any moment. I calm myself, then move up to stand beside Persicaria before returning Malkira's gaze.

spans.text: Persicaria stands before me with her sword in hand, ready to attack the uninvited guest at any moment. I calm myself, then move up to stand beside Persicaria before returning Malkira's gaze.

units.rawText: <color=red>Oh, there's no need to be so wary, <cmdr>. As a token of gratitude for coming as you promised, I have a little gift for you.</color>
units.displayText: Oh, there's no need to be so wary, {교수}. As a token of gratitude for coming as you promised, I have a little gift for you.

spans.text: Oh, there's no need to be so wary,
. As a token of gratitude for coming as you promised, I have a little gift for you.

units.rawText: Would you actually be that kind?
units.displayText: Would you actually be that kind?

spans.text: Would you actually be that kind?

units.rawText: <color=red>Oh please, I am hardly an irredeemable villain. Our kind are not like you humans; beyond our primal desires lies an unfettered sincerity.</color>
units.displayText: Oh please, I am hardly an irredeemable villain. Our kind are not like you humans; beyond our primal desires lies an unfettered sincerity.

spans.text: Oh please, I am hardly an irredeemable villain. Our kind are not like you humans; beyond our primal desires lies an unfettered sincerity.

units.rawText: <color=red>You can label me whatever you wish, but I would like you to at least hear me out first.</color>
units.displayText: You can label me whatever you wish, but I would like you to at least hear me out first.

spans.text: You can label me whatever you wish, but I would like you to at least hear me out first.

units.rawText: It seems that Tartarus has the upper hand now. Are you still willing to negotiate with us at a time like this?
units.displayText: It seems that Tartarus has the upper hand now. Are you still willing to negotiate with us at a time like this?

spans.text: It seems that Tartarus has the upper hand now. Are you still willing to negotiate with us at a time like this?

units.rawText: <color=red>Of course. You are worthy of the lengths I have gone to in order to facilitate this meeting. In turn, I would like you to negotiate with me with similar sincerity.</color>
units.displayText: Of course. You are worthy of the lengths I have gone to in order to facilitate this meeting. In turn, I would like you to negotiate with me with similar sincerity.

spans.text: Of course. You are worthy of the lengths I have gone to in order to facilitate this meeting. In turn, I would like you to negotiate with me with similar sincerity.

units.rawText: <color=red>The Entropics are not given to kindness. I hope you will live up to the honor that has been bestowed upon you, <cmdr>.</color>
units.displayText: The Entropics are not given to kindness. I hope you will live up to the honor that has been bestowed upon you, {교수}.

spans.text: The Entropics are not given to kindness. I hope you will live up to the honor that has been bestowed upon you,

units.rawText: <color=red>In addition, I dislike having too many people around. Just the presence of you and I will be sufficient for the negotiations.</color>
units.displayText: In addition, I dislike having too many people around. Just the presence of you and I will be sufficient for the negotiations.

spans.text: In addition, I dislike having too many people around. Just the presence of you and I will be sufficient for the negotiations.

units.rawText: ...No wonder our team was scattered by the Entropics and our backup was further encircled by them.
units.displayText: ...No wonder our team was scattered by the Entropics and our backup was further encircled by them.

spans.text: ...No wonder our team was scattered by the Entropics and our backup was further encircled by them.

units.rawText: It would seem you orchestrated both mine and Persicaria's abnormally successful arrival in Tartarus.
units.displayText: It would seem you orchestrated both mine and Persicaria's abnormally successful arrival in Tartarus.

spans.text: It would seem you orchestrated both mine and Persicaria's abnormally successful arrival in Tartarus.

units.rawText: <color=red>Please understand that I have difficulties of my own. I would have a lot of trouble explaining to Eosphorus how and why I let so many people into Tartarus at once.</color>
units.displayText: Please understand that I have difficulties of my own. I would have a lot of trouble explaining to Eosphorus how and why I let so many people into Tartarus at once.

spans.text: Please understand that I have difficulties of my own. I would have a lot of trouble explaining to Eosphorus how and why I let so many people into Tartarus at once.

units.rawText: I didn't expect you to be so subservient to him.
units.displayText: I didn't expect you to be so subservient to him.

spans.text: I didn't expect you to be so subservient to him.

units.rawText: <color=red>Hoho, there's no need to phrase it that way. Nobody would want unexpected developments taking place at such a key period.</color>
units.displayText: Hoho, there's no need to phrase it that way. Nobody would want unexpected developments taking place at such a key period.

spans.text: Hoho, there's no need to phrase it that way. Nobody would want unexpected developments taking place at such a key period.

units.rawText: <color=red>Consider, that Miss Eos of yours went to great lengths to generate the Spoof Code you're using now, which is what made Eosphorus view you as Sanctifiers and not an expedition from the Oasis. Would it not go to waste if you were to arouse his suspicion by your numbers?</color>
units.displayText: Consider, that Miss Eos of yours went to great lengths to generate the Spoof Code you're using now, which is what made Eosphorus view you as Sanctifiers and not an expedition from the Oasis. Would it not go to waste if you were to arouse his suspicion by your numbers?

spans.text: Consider, that Miss Eos of yours went to great lengths to generate the Spoof Code you're using now, which is what made Eosphorus view you as Sanctifiers and not an expedition from the Oasis. Would it not go to waste if you were to arouse his suspicion by your numbers?

units.rawText: ...It seems you've seen right through us.
units.displayText: ...It seems you've seen right through us.

spans.text: ...It seems you've seen right through us.

units.rawText: <color=red>You are most kind. I did my homework in preparation for this meeting.</color>
units.displayText: You are most kind. I did my homework in preparation for this meeting.

spans.text: You are most kind. I did my homework in preparation for this meeting.

units.rawText: <color=red>A friendly reminder: My children are cute, but there is a limit to their patience. If your other team members do not withdraw, they might end up being torn to bits.</color>
units.displayText: A friendly reminder: My children are cute, but there is a limit to their patience. If your other team members do not withdraw, they might end up being torn to bits.

spans.text: A friendly reminder: My children are cute, but there is a limit to their patience. If your other team members do not withdraw, they might end up being torn to bits.

units.rawText: <color=red>I trust neither of us would want to witness such a scene... As such, I believe you know what to do next, <cmdr>.</color>
units.displayText: I trust neither of us would want to witness such a scene... As such, I believe you know what to do next, {교수}.

spans.text: I trust neither of us would want to witness such a scene... As such, I believe you know what to do next,

units.rawText: ...Understood.
units.displayText: ...Understood.

spans.text: ...Understood.

units.rawText: <color=red>Very good. However, considering that you are a fragile human being, I must at least make sure you don't end up filling the bellies of my starving children until you reach me.</color>
units.displayText: Very good. However, considering that you are a fragile human being, I must at least make sure you don't end up filling the bellies of my starving children until you reach me.

spans.text: Very good. However, considering that you are a fragile human being, I must at least make sure you don't end up filling the bellies of my starving children until you reach me.

units.rawText: <color=red>Therefore, I have permitted you to bring one capable helper along. It seems she has discharged her duties admirably.</color>
units.displayText: Therefore, I have permitted you to bring one capable helper along. It seems she has discharged her duties admirably.

spans.text: Therefore, I have permitted you to bring one capable helper along. It seems she has discharged her duties admirably.

units.rawText: <color=red>Also, a gentle reminder that you should pick up the pace. Currently, we are savoring the sweet taste of victory at the expense of your comrades' suffering.</color>
units.displayText: Also, a gentle reminder that you should pick up the pace. Currently, we are savoring the sweet taste of victory at the expense of your comrades' suffering.

spans.text: Also, a gentle reminder that you should pick up the pace. Currently, we are savoring the sweet taste of victory at the expense of your comrades' suffering.

units.rawText: <color=red>I wonder, how long they will hold out whilst being on the chopping block?</color>
units.displayText: I wonder, how long they will hold out whilst being on the chopping block?

spans.text: I wonder, how long they will hold out whilst being on the chopping block?

units.rawText: I don't need you to inform me of the situation on the frontlines. I was always going to meet with you. Even if you manage to stop my escort team, my determination remains.
units.displayText: I don't need you to inform me of the situation on the frontlines. I was always going to meet with you. Even if you manage to stop my escort team, my determination remains.

spans.text: I don't need you to inform me of the situation on the frontlines. I was always going to meet with you. Even if you manage to stop my escort team, my determination remains.

units.rawText: <color=red>Your forthrightness is most refreshing.</color>
units.displayText: Your forthrightness is most refreshing.

spans.text: Your forthrightness is most refreshing.

units.rawText: The Diminutive Entropic wiggles its stubby tentacles, and there seems to be a hint of reluctance in its voice.
units.displayText: The Diminutive Entropic wiggles its stubby tentacles, and there seems to be a hint of reluctance in its voice.

spans.text: The Diminutive Entropic wiggles its stubby tentacles, and there seems to be a hint of reluctance in its voice.

units.rawText: <color=red>As much as I'd like to speak further with you, it seems this little one is about to wake up.</color>
units.displayText: As much as I'd like to speak further with you, it seems this little one is about to wake up.

spans.text: As much as I'd like to speak further with you, it seems this little one is about to wake up.

units.rawText: <color=red>This will be the last time I borrow her body to speak with you. Soon, she will regain her sense of self through the power of Tartarus.</color>
units.displayText: This will be the last time I borrow her body to speak with you. Soon, she will regain her sense of self through the power of Tartarus.

spans.text: This will be the last time I borrow her body to speak with you. Soon, she will regain her sense of self through the power of Tartarus.

units.rawText: <color=red>When the time comes, I will no longer be able to control her, but she will be a reliable guide and shall lead you to the gift I have kindly prepared for you.</color>
units.displayText: When the time comes, I will no longer be able to control her, but she will be a reliable guide and shall lead you to the gift I have kindly prepared for you.

spans.text: When the time comes, I will no longer be able to control her, but she will be a reliable guide and shall lead you to the gift I have kindly prepared for you.

units.rawText: <color=red>Should you find said gift to your tastes, I hope it will improve your evaluation of me in your eyes when we finally meet. I trust you will be eager to listen to me once you receive it.</color>
units.displayText: Should you find said gift to your tastes, I hope it will improve your evaluation of me in your eyes when we finally meet. I trust you will be eager to listen to me once you receive it.

spans.text: Should you find said gift to your tastes, I hope it will improve your evaluation of me in your eyes when we finally meet. I trust you will be eager to listen to me once you receive it.

units.rawText: <color=red>Remember to be kind to your guide. I hope you will live up to my trust in your character, fufufu...</color>
units.displayText: Remember to be kind to your guide. I hope you will live up to my trust in your character, fufufu...

spans.text: Remember to be kind to your guide. I hope you will live up to my trust in your character, fufufu...

units.rawText: Her sinister laughter echoes through the safehouse and inside my ears, but before it can fade, Malkira speaks once more, her words the captivating call of a witch's temptations.
units.displayText: Her sinister laughter echoes through the safehouse and inside my ears, but before it can fade, Malkira speaks once more, her words the captivating call of a witch's temptations.

spans.text: Her sinister laughter echoes through the safehouse and inside my ears, but before it can fade, Malkira speaks once more, her words the captivating call of a witch's temptations.

units.rawText: <color=red>Now awaken, my beloved little sister...</color>
units.displayText: Now awaken, my beloved little sister...

spans.text: Now awaken, my beloved little sister...

units.rawText: <color=red>Use that dance you know best to tell them where the nectar is found; lead these lost travelers to harvest the surprise that awaits them, for they shall gorge upon its fragrance...</color>
units.displayText: Use that dance you know best to tell them where the nectar is found; lead these lost travelers to harvest the surprise that awaits them, for they shall gorge upon its fragrance...

spans.text: Use that dance you know best to tell them where the nectar is found; lead these lost travelers to harvest the surprise that awaits them, for they shall gorge upon its fragrance...

units.rawText: Her muttering acts like a potent accelerant that causes the body of the Diminutive Entropic which serves as a communication device, to rapidly swell and expand. A youthful face emerges from its round body, and two of its tentacles seem to be shaped and bound by an invisible force, sprouting a pair of hands like slender shoots.

units.rawText: That's...!
units.displayText: That's...!

spans.text: That's...!

units.rawText: <color=red>Her ruined body once stood in the Copley Sector as a tombstone. I trust you remember the epitaph engraved upon it.</color>
units.displayText: Her ruined body once stood in the Copley Sector as a tombstone. I trust you remember the epitaph engraved upon it.

spans.text: Her ruined body once stood in the Copley Sector as a tombstone. I trust you remember the epitaph engraved upon it.

units.rawText: Light...
units.displayText: Light...

spans.text: Light...

units.rawText: <color=orange>Demiurge.</color>
units.displayText: Demiurge.

spans.text: Demiurge.

units.rawText: I clench my fists and go on high alert. My eyes are fixed upon the roly-poly juvenile on the ground before me, not daring to relax for a moment.
units.displayText: I clench my fists and go on high alert. My eyes are fixed upon the roly-poly juvenile on the ground before me, not daring to relax for a moment.

spans.text: I clench my fists and go on high alert. My eyes are fixed upon the roly-poly juvenile on the ground before me, not daring to relax for a moment.

units.rawText: <color=red>Be at ease. Though she was spawned amidst filth and corruption, she is the purest soul on the cloud. From then till now, that has always been so. Mutually illuminated by your noble natures, she is certainly qualified to be your guide.</color>
units.displayText: Be at ease. Though she was spawned amidst filth and corruption, she is the purest soul on the cloud. From then till now, that has always been so. Mutually illuminated by your noble natures, she is certainly qualified to be your guide.

spans.text: Be at ease. Though she was spawned amidst filth and corruption, she is the purest soul on the cloud. From then till now, that has always been so. Mutually illuminated by your noble natures, she is certainly qualified to be your guide.

units.rawText: <color=red>If you follow her directions, you shall behold the gift that has been prepared for you. I look forward to our meeting...</color>
units.displayText: If you follow her directions, you shall behold the gift that has been prepared for you. I look forward to our meeting...

spans.text: If you follow her directions, you shall behold the gift that has been prepared for you. I look forward to our meeting...

units.rawText: As Malkira's voice fades, the young Demiurge closes her eyes again and slumps to the ground.
units.displayText: As Malkira's voice fades, the young Demiurge closes her eyes again and slumps to the ground.

spans.text: As Malkira's voice fades, the young Demiurge closes her eyes again and slumps to the ground.

units.rawText: ...She hasn't made any threatening moves so far. I believe she will wake up soon.
units.displayText: ...She hasn't made any threatening moves so far. I believe she will wake up soon.

spans.text: ...She hasn't made any threatening moves so far. I believe she will wake up soon.

units.rawText: Professor, what will you do now?
units.displayText: Professor, what will you do now?

spans.text: Professor, what will you do now?

units.rawText: Persicaria, put me through to Eos.
units.displayText: Persicaria, put me through to Eos.

spans.text: Persicaria, put me through to Eos.

units.rawText: Understood.
units.displayText: Understood.

spans.text: Understood.

units.rawText: Professor?
units.displayText: Professor?

spans.text: Professor?

units.rawText: Eos's face looks a little tired in the transmission window, but she smiles reassuringly the moment she sees me.
units.displayText: Eos's face looks a little tired in the transmission window, but she smiles reassuringly the moment she sees me.

spans.text: Eos's face looks a little tired in the transmission window, but she smiles reassuringly the moment she sees me.

units.rawText: I'm glad to see you well. Please give me a little more time; I will direct the Oasis' and the Sanctifiers' support teams to break out of this cordon and aid you...
units.displayText: I'm glad to see you well. Please give me a little more time; I will direct the Oasis' and the Sanctifiers' support teams to break out of this cordon and aid you...

spans.text: I'm glad to see you well. Please give me a little more time; I will direct the Oasis' and the Sanctifiers' support teams to break out of this cordon and aid you...

units.rawText: There's no need for that, Eos. I've seen their combat reports. They are surrounded by Entropics and their situation does not look good.
units.displayText: There's no need for that, Eos. I've seen their combat reports. They are surrounded by Entropics and their situation does not look good.

spans.text: There's no need for that, Eos. I've seen their combat reports. They are surrounded by Entropics and their situation does not look good.

units.rawText: Change of plans; order them to fall back and help you guard the flanks at the Reverse Tower battlefront.
units.displayText: Change of plans; order them to fall back and help you guard the flanks at the Reverse Tower battlefront.

spans.text: Change of plans; order them to fall back and help you guard the flanks at the Reverse Tower battlefront.

units.rawText: ...Does this mean you and Persicaria will forfeit the protection of the other teams and advance into Tartarus by yourselves?
units.displayText: ...Does this mean you and Persicaria will forfeit the protection of the other teams and advance into Tartarus by yourselves?

spans.text: ...Does this mean you and Persicaria will forfeit the protection of the other teams and advance into Tartarus by yourselves?

units.rawText: With all due respect, that is most unwise.
units.displayText: With all due respect, that is most unwise.

spans.text: With all due respect, that is most unwise.

units.rawText: I'm sure you could force your way through the Entropic blockade, but Malkira is not showing any signs of hostility at the moment, and advancing recklessly will only lead to needless casualties and potentially upsetting her.
units.displayText: I'm sure you could force your way through the Entropic blockade, but Malkira is not showing any signs of hostility at the moment, and advancing recklessly will only lead to needless casualties and potentially upsetting her.

spans.text: I'm sure you could force your way through the Entropic blockade, but Malkira is not showing any signs of hostility at the moment, and advancing recklessly will only lead to needless casualties and potentially upsetting her.

units.rawText: Besides, Irida and Hesperus are buying time for us on the battlefield. We haven't the time to waste on skirmishes here.
units.displayText: Besides, Irida and Hesperus are buying time for us on the battlefield. We haven't the time to waste on skirmishes here.

spans.text: Besides, Irida and Hesperus are buying time for us on the battlefield. We haven't the time to waste on skirmishes here.

units.rawText: ...Understood. I will lead them to the Reverse Tower and help buy more time for you.
units.displayText: ...Understood. I will lead them to the Reverse Tower and help buy more time for you.

spans.text: ...Understood. I will lead them to the Reverse Tower and help buy more time for you.

units.rawText: Counting on you, Eos.
units.displayText: Counting on you, Eos.

spans.text: Counting on you, Eos.

units.rawText: While I cannot directly assist you, please do not forget this.
units.displayText: While I cannot directly assist you, please do not forget this.

spans.text: While I cannot directly assist you, please do not forget this.

units.rawText: Eos sweeps her hair back and reveals a single earring, edged in azure and gold.
units.displayText: Eos sweeps her hair back and reveals a single earring, edged in azure and gold.

spans.text: Eos sweeps her hair back and reveals a single earring, edged in azure and gold.

units.rawText: I'm sure you have a similar article in your possession. I know we will all have our hands full on the battlefield, but even so, I hope you will take care of yourself amidst the fighting.
units.displayText: I'm sure you have a similar article in your possession. I know we will all have our hands full on the battlefield, but even so, I hope you will take care of yourself amidst the fighting.

spans.text: I'm sure you have a similar article in your possession. I know we will all have our hands full on the battlefield, but even so, I hope you will take care of yourself amidst the fighting.

units.rawText: That earring has been treated with an application of Spoof Code technology and contains part of my operands.
units.displayText: That earring has been treated with an application of Spoof Code technology and contains part of my operands.

spans.text: That earring has been treated with an application of Spoof Code technology and contains part of my operands.

units.rawText: If needed, please use it to protect yourself. Even if you are separated from your companions, you can use it to find your way.
units.displayText: If needed, please use it to protect yourself. Even if you are separated from your companions, you can use it to find your way.

spans.text: If needed, please use it to protect yourself. Even if you are separated from your companions, you can use it to find your way.

units.rawText: I nod, and take its matching twin out from a pocket to show Eos. She smiles in relief before finally ending the transmission and ordering the rest of the team to hurry over to the flank.
units.displayText: I nod, and take its matching twin out from a pocket to show Eos. She smiles in relief before finally ending the transmission and ordering the rest of the team to hurry over to the flank.

spans.text: I nod, and take its matching twin out from a pocket to show Eos. She smiles in relief before finally ending the transmission and ordering the rest of the team to hurry over to the flank.

units.rawText: ...Professor, just how much of what Malkira said do you think was truthful?
units.displayText: ...Professor, just how much of what Malkira said do you think was truthful?

spans.text: ...Professor, just how much of what Malkira said do you think was truthful?

units.rawText: That's not up to us. We have no choice but to give it a try even if we know she's lying. The Sanctifiers are having a hard time on the frontlines and the situation in each sector is dire. We'll either be negotiating with Malkira or advancing into a position where we might have a chance to assassinate her.

units.rawText: If it comes to that, we'll have to use our final trump card. Fortunately, Malkira does not seem to be in a bloodthirsty mood. In fact, she's been expressing nothing but goodwill so far. Thus, seeking negotiations with her are our current priority.

units.rawText: Understood. Since you have decided to accept her invitation, I shall not question it further, and will aid you with all my strength.
units.displayText: Understood. Since you have decided to accept her invitation, I shall not question it further, and will aid you with all my strength.

spans.text: Understood. Since you have decided to accept her invitation, I shall not question it further, and will aid you with all my strength.

units.rawText: Thank you, Persicaria.
units.displayText: Thank you, Persicaria.

spans.text: Thank you, Persicaria.

units.rawText: Now then, let's see when our little Sleeping Beauty will wake up.
units.displayText: Now then, let's see when our little Sleeping Beauty will wake up.

spans.text: Now then, let's see when our little Sleeping Beauty will wake up.

units.rawText: Should I poke her face?
units.displayText: Should I poke her face?

spans.text: Should I poke her face?

units.rawText: I carefully examine the sleeping Demi.
units.displayText: I carefully examine the sleeping Demi.

spans.text: I carefully examine the sleeping Demi.

units.rawText: The terrain in Tartarus shifts at regular intervals, and without a guide, we'll end up lost and trapped in a labyrinth if we try to go deeper... Uwah!
units.displayText: The terrain in Tartarus shifts at regular intervals, and without a guide, we'll end up lost and trapped in a labyrinth if we try to go deeper... Uwah!

spans.text: The terrain in Tartarus shifts at regular intervals, and without a guide, we'll end up lost and trapped in a labyrinth if we try to go deeper... Uwah!

units.rawText: Before she can finish, a violent shaking washes over us. I can't steady myself with Demiurge in my arms and stumble several steps back before falling into Persicaria's arms.
units.displayText: Before she can finish, a violent shaking washes over us. I can't steady myself with Demiurge in my arms and stumble several steps back before falling into Persicaria's arms.

spans.text: Before she can finish, a violent shaking washes over us. I can't steady myself with Demiurge in my arms and stumble several steps back before falling into Persicaria's arms.

units.rawText: Right on cue. Looks like this is Tartarus' shifting window...
units.displayText: Right on cue. Looks like this is Tartarus' shifting window...

spans.text: Right on cue. Looks like this is Tartarus' shifting window...

units.rawText: The sleeping girl is startled awake. She rubs her heavy-lidded eyes and raises her head.
units.displayText: The sleeping girl is startled awake. She rubs her heavy-lidded eyes and raises her head.

spans.text: The sleeping girl is startled awake. She rubs her heavy-lidded eyes and raises her head.

units.rawText: She's awake!
units.displayText: She's awake!

spans.text: She's awake!

units.rawText: Persicaria helps me up and points at the girl in the crook of my arm. Her gaze moves between me and Persicaria, and several seconds later, her face lights up with a smile.
units.displayText: Persicaria helps me up and points at the girl in the crook of my arm. Her gaze moves between me and Persicaria, and several seconds later, her face lights up with a smile.

spans.text: Persicaria helps me up and points at the girl in the crook of my arm. Her gaze moves between me and Persicaria, and several seconds later, her face lights up with a smile.

units.rawText: ■...Puh... fessa...
units.displayText: ■...Puh... fessa...

spans.text: ■...Puh... fessa...

units.rawText: I can make out some familiar syllables in her broken speech and I am certain that she is calling out to me.
units.displayText: I can make out some familiar syllables in her broken speech and I am certain that she is calling out to me.

spans.text: I can make out some familiar syllables in her broken speech and I am certain that she is calling out to me.

units.rawText: I suppose the fact that she still remembers me calls for some fireworks.
units.displayText: I suppose the fact that she still remembers me calls for some fireworks.

spans.text: I suppose the fact that she still remembers me calls for some fireworks.

units.rawText: Hehe, looks like she remembers her time as that tiny Entropic.
units.displayText: Hehe, looks like she remembers her time as that tiny Entropic.

spans.text: Hehe, looks like she remembers her time as that tiny Entropic.

units.rawText: Demi jumps down from my arms, then grabs my leg and tugs on me.
units.displayText: Demi jumps down from my arms, then grabs my leg and tugs on me.

spans.text: Demi jumps down from my arms, then grabs my leg and tugs on me.

units.rawText: Go with you?!
units.displayText: Go with you?!

spans.text: Go with you?!

units.rawText: Yea...
units.displayText: Yea...

spans.text: Yea...

units.rawText: She nods and wiggles her tentacles. It's plain to see that she's very happy to be back in Tartarus; even the speed at which she wiggles her tentacles has picked up.
units.displayText: She nods and wiggles her tentacles. It's plain to see that she's very happy to be back in Tartarus; even the speed at which she wiggles her tentacles has picked up.

spans.text: She nods and wiggles her tentacles. It's plain to see that she's very happy to be back in Tartarus; even the speed at which she wiggles her tentacles has picked up.

units.rawText: So this is the guide Malkira was talking about...
units.displayText: So this is the guide Malkira was talking about...

spans.text: So this is the guide Malkira was talking about...

units.rawText: Hehe, she's small, but she's doing her job well.
units.displayText: Hehe, she's small, but she's doing her job well.

units.displayText: Persicaria and I hurry to match her pace.

units.displayText: The moment we leave the safehouse, I look up at the walls in the distance. Tartarus's shifting labyrinth looks back at us with a completely different face.

units.rawText: Looks like we'll have to feel our way through whatever lies ahead by ourselves...
units.displayText: Looks like we'll have to feel our way through whatever lies ahead by ourselves...

units.rawText: Professor?
units.displayText: Professor?

spans.text: Professor?

units.rawText: It's nothing. Let's go.
units.displayText: It's nothing. Let's go.

spans.text: It's nothing. Let's go.
